description: This file contains implementation code for a class that generates Visual Studio project and solution files, including methods for writing project configurations, filtering targets, and managing solution folder structure. It is part of a build system that integrates with Visual Studio, handling project file creation, filtering, and solution organization.

classes.name: SolutionEntry
classes.description: Represents a solution folder or project entry with name, path, guid, and optional parent folder.

classes.name: SolutionProject
classes.description: Represents a Visual Studio project with additional path and configuration details.

classes.name: SourceFileCompileTypePair
classes.description: Associates a source file with its compile type in the project.

classes.name: VisualStudioWriter
classes.description: Main class responsible for generating Visual Studio project and solution files, managing project configurations, filtering targets, and organizing solution folders.

methods.name: RunAndWriteFiles
methods.description: Static method to generate and write Visual Studio solution and project files based on build targets.

methods.name: WriteProjectFiles
methods.description: Generates project files for a specific target.

methods.name: WriteProjectFileContents
methods.description: Writes the content of a project file (.vcxproj).

methods.name: WriteFiltersFileContents
methods.description: Creates the filters (.filters) file for source organization.

methods.name: WriteSolutionFileContents
methods.description: Writes the content of the solution file.

methods.name: ResolveSolutionFolders
methods.description: Organizes folders within the solution based on project paths.

methods.name: GetNinjaTarget
methods.description: Determines the ninja build target name for a given target.

methods.name: GetNinjaExecutable
methods.description: Returns the ninja executable name, defaulting to 'ninja.exe'.
